0022600203.text: The Hawks (6-4, first in the Southeast and fourth in the East) host the Lakers on a three-game winning streak, though they are 2-2 at home, and they are missing Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Jock Landale (hip), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture). Los Angeles arrives at 8-2, first in the Pacific and first in the West, on a four-game winning streak, and the teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27 after splitting their 2025-26 series 1-1. The most recent meeting was a 141-116 Lakers win in Los Angeles on January 13, 2026.
